results.title: Macy Murdoch: Back to the Past
results.original_title: Macy Murdoch: Back to the Past
results.overview: Macy and friends find the mysteriously re-built time machine and travel to the past only to find a dead Macy in the morgue! Using forensic clues, Macy must stop her own death from happening.

results.title: Katherine Levac: L'homme de ma vie
results.original_title: Katherine Levac: L'homme de ma vie
results.overview: Katherine Levac, a leading comedian of her generation, returns to the stage: sharp, sarcastic and incisive, with an offbeat take on life.

results.title: Radiant Frost
results.overview: A drifter’s life takes a dramatic turn when he discovers a runaway member of a survivalist cult in the back of his truck.

results.title: Remnants of memory
results.overview: Jeisson Castillo, a Colombian artist, returns to the Amazon to continue an art workshop with children from the indigenous community of El Itilla. But while painting in a sacred place, an unexpected illness transforms his journey. Guided by the traditional knowledge of Kumú, he begins a profound healing process that questions the boundaries between art, territory, memory, and spirituality.

results.title: Fly
results.overview: In 2005 rural Bulgaria, lonely 30-year-old Ovanes spends his days between a dull job at the local butcher shop and late nights chatting online. One day, he begins an unexpected virtual friendship with Ollie.

results.title: Dragoons
results.overview: The documentary delves into the images that shaped the political myth of Jair Bolsonaro, from his earliest YouTube videos to the end of his term in office. Over a series of sleepless nights, a narrator drifts through Bolsonaro’s livestreams, selfies, and speeches, searching for the logic of a form of power forged through and by images. By confronting this visual regime with Brazil’s official iconography, the film explores how power is understood, repeated, and asserted through images, at a time when politics increasingly unfolds on screens.

results.title: Macha
results.overview: Dismissed after surgery for endometriosis and left without answers,Ana draws on the strength of Macha to reclaim her voice and confront the system ignoring her pain, while her father grapples with the helplessness of loving someone he cannot heal.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 12
results.overview: The twelfth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 6, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, and was headlined by an A Block match between Yota Tsuji and Boltin Oleg.

results.title: Dora
results.overview: A family retreats to the seaside, far from the bustle of Seoul. Their daughter, Dora, suffers from a mysterious illness. Her discovery of love unleashes a force as powerful as it is dangerous, with far-reaching consequences for those around her…

results.title: 963 Days: The Story of a President who Put Brazil Back on Track
results.original_title: 963 Dias: A História de um Presidente que Recolocou o Brasil nos Trilhos
results.overview: A documentary that chronicles the political trajectory of former president Michel Temer (MDB) during the 963 days he was in charge of the Planalto Palace.

results.title: Mismantler
results.overview: A dark, stream of consciousness fever dream, gathering all that is decrepit in this world, and reflecting it all back to those who have reduced the Earth to what it is.

results.title: Kissyfoot
results.overview: When Laura joins therapy and bemoans her misshapen leg, all Megan can see is a cute little foot. A ‘kissyfoot’ is what her critical husband would call it. As their friendship develops, Megan offers a simple, grisly solution that will make them both feel complete.

results.title: Sting - Sounds Like Art Rijksmuseum Amsterdam
results.original_title: Sting - Sounds Like Art Rijksmuseum Amsterdam
results.overview: World-renowned artist Sting performs in the beautiful surroundings of Amsterdam’s Rijksmuseum amongst paintings by Rembrandt, Vermeer and Judith Leyster, and reflects on the works of the old masters.  The 17-time Grammy Award winning artist performs a unique concert amongst masterpieces in the Gallery of Honour. Playing a rare 17th century guitar, Sting, managed by Martin Kierszenbaum/Cherrytree Music Company, reveals his love for the Old Masters and revels in the power of books and reading, while performing in the museum’s spectacular library.  Accompanied by his longtime guitarist Dominic Miller, Sting reflects on the musical’s origins, shares stories from throughout his career, and performs beloved songs spanning his illustrious catalogue, including classics from his celebrated band, The Police.  For the occasion, Sting plays a unique 17th-century guitar - originally crafted for the court of Louis XIV, the Sun King -  generously loaned to the museum.

results.title: To Be
results.overview: Jack Adler is a dreamer. He feels that soulless poetry recitation is an injustice to the meaning between the lines, and he hungers for connection with others who cherish the truth of storytelling as much as he does. When Jack stumbles upon an artistic safe haven, he learns he may not be so alone after all.

results.title: Student Film: The Movie
results.overview: A down-on-his-luck professor and a group of college students must win a local film festival to save their university's film program.

results.title: Parents' House
results.overview: Flight attendant Dasha decides to sell her grandmother's house and buy an apartment in the capital. She arrives in the village, where she meets her first love, a simple village cheese maker, Misha. He and his young nephew Petrovich turn a real estate deal into a real challenge. Over time, Dasha begins to realize that her parents' house is not for sale.
